hypotheses.C1_unit_input_rank16_is_compact: The basis-invariant unit-input response has median rank-16 energy at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C2_unit_input_rank4_is_compact: The basis-invariant unit-input response has median rank-4 energy at least 0.75 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C3_basis_rotation_invariance: An orthogonal rotation of the input basis changes rank energies by at most 1e-4 and the leading output subspace overlap remains at least 0.999.
hypotheses.C4_axes_recur_globally: Median rank-4 Fisher output-subspace overlap between random sites is at least 0.25 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C5_prediction_class_explains_recurrence: Pairs sharing the native top-prediction class have at least 0.05 greater output-subspace overlap than pairs with different classes.
hypotheses.C6_token_labels_recur: Median optimally aligned top-token Jaccard is at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C7_softmax_geometry_can_support_rank4: The pure-softmax top-256 principal Fisher lower bound has at least as much rank-4 energy as the model response, within 0.10, on both corpora.
hypotheses.C8_unweighted_logit_axes_recur: After removing softmax probability weighting, the median rank-4 logit-subspace overlap between random sites is at least 0.25 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C9_input_verbs_recur: The leading rank-4 Layer-8 input sensitivity subspace has median overlap at least 0.25 between random sites on both corpora.
